name: DropzoneButton
title: File upload dropzone with button
description: A drag-and-drop file area with idle/accept/reject states and an overlapping Select files button. Use for uploads like resumes or PDFs where you want both drag-drop and a click-to-browse control.

i18nKeys.dropzonebutton__description: Drag'n'drop files here to upload. We can accept only .pdf files that are less than 30mb in size.
